Bloom-alpha writers: flipbook/plain/gradient/whiteboost emission, vertex emission, _RIMLIGHT_ADDITIVE overwrite, _RIMLIGHT_LERP overwrite via ApplyRimLight. Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); baseColor.a feeds COLOR_ARRAY path and vertex-color multiply; material color-array path multiplies rgb by _Intensity and a by _AlphaMultiplier (Lit 1750-1754). _VERTEXMODE_COLOR multiplies baseColor by i.color.; n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); baseColor.rgb scales ambient+direct (+lightmap) and tints fast/precise reflection multiply paths; occlusion multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha when after emission); occlusion-detail always multiplies rgb after distance-darkening; directDiffuse+directSpecular added into albedo rgb with metallic terms; groundFade scales directBaseColor pre-light and specular post-light; specular multiplied by occlusion when OCCLUSION (before emission ordering splits occlusion rgb timing); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic; alpha untouched here; albedo=0 then += (reflection+ambient+directDiffuse+directSpecular) with a=0; hologram adds rgb (grid*colorScale*intensity*holoColor; scanline scan*intensity*holoColor; legacy holo*holoColor); scanline forces a=0; distance-darkening multiplies rgb; occlusion-before (+detail) multiplies rgb before ACES/emission; ACES-before optional on rgb+a passthrough; parallax adds to rgb only (iridescent: +=blend*a; non-iridescent: +=layer*parallaxColor.rgb); alpha untouched; each emission writer does rgb+=color and a+=bloomAlpha (flipbook) or a=+bloomAlpha from 0-start (simple/pulse/SDF path starts emissionInput=0 then albedo.a+=bloomAlpha, so first writer sets alpha; Angle disappearance scales emissionInput pre-alpha-source; TEXTURE3D_EMISSION scales emissionColor.a pre-branch.; additive rim adds rgb and OVERWRITES a (=rim*scale*bloomI); lerp rim lerps rgb toward rimTarget and OVERWRITES a; UV-segment rim color overrides material rim color under _RIMLIGHT_LERP; occlusion-after-emission later scales additive-rim alpha (R16); occlusion-after multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha); ACES-after applies to rgb+a passthrough; highlight adds rgb pulse; COLOR_BY_FOG (non-bloomfog, non-grid/legacy hologram) replaces via ApplyColorFog height-weighted blend; bloomfog blends rgb+a toward prepass via fogFactor (BlendFogColor selects a vs rgb vs full by _FOGTYPE_*; Lit defines none => full bloomfogCol overwrite). Height variant uses (heightFog*-fog+1) weighting. Plain FOG+HEIGHT (non-colorfog, non-grid/legacy) lerps rgb toward grey 0.1 by height factor (alpha preserved: float4(0.1,0.1,0.1,0)-result weighting keeps a). operation_order: No transparency: defaults One/Zero RGB and Zero/Zero bloom-alpha => opaque; albedo.a is bloom (glow) channel consumed by bloom prepass/post, not transparency. Bloom-alpha writers: flipbook/plain/gradient/whiteboost emission, vertex emission, _RIMLIGHT_ADDITIVE overwrite, _RIMLIGHT_LERP overwrite via ApplyRimLight. Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); baseColor.a feeds COLOR_ARRAY path and vertex-color multiply; material color-array path multiplies rgb by _Intensity and a by _AlphaMultiplier (Lit 1750-1754). _VERTEXMODE_COLOR multiplies baseColor by i.color.; n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); baseColor.rgb scales ambient+direct (+lightmap) and tints fast/precise reflection multiply paths; occlusion multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha when after emission); occlusion-detail always multiplies rgb after distance-darkening; directDiffuse+directSpecular added into albedo rgb with metallic terms; groundFade scales directBaseColor pre-light and specular post-light; specular multiplied by occlusion when OCCLUSION (before emission ordering splits occlusion rgb timing); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic; alpha untouched here; albedo=0 then += (reflection+ambient+directDiffuse+directSpecular) with a=0; hologram adds rgb (grid*colorScale*intensity*holoColor; scanline scan*intensity*holoColor; legacy holo*holoColor); scanline forces a=0; distance-darkening multiplies rgb; occlusion-before (+detail) multiplies rgb before ACES/emission; ACES-before optional on rgb+a passthrough; parallax adds to rgb only (iridescent: +=blend*a; non-iridescent: +=layer*parallaxColor.rgb); alpha untouched; each emission writer does rgb+=color and a+=bloomAlpha (flipbook) or a=+bloomAlpha from 0-start (simple/pulse/SDF path starts emissionInput=0 then albedo.a+=bloomAlpha, so first writer sets alpha; flipbook path sets a= then +=vertex). Gradient: color=intensity*saturate(x*gradLUT), a=_TexBloomIntensity*intensity (luminance-independent). Whiteboost/MainEffect: rgb=saturate premult+whiteboost via CalculateBloomComposition, a=(g^2*a)*3.5*_TexBloom. Plain: rgb=x*color.rgb*a, a=(g^2*a)*3.5*_TexBloom. Vertex: rgb per whiteboost branch else color.rgb*a*threshold, a=vc.a^2*color.a*_EmissionBloom. Angle disappearance scales emissionInput pre-alpha-source; TEXTURE3D_EMISSION scales emissionColor.a pre-branch.; additive rim adds rgb and OVERWRITES a (=rim*scale*bloomI); lerp rim lerps rgb toward rimTarget and OVERWRITES a; UV-segment rim color overrides material rim color under _RIMLIGHT_LERP; occlusion-after-emission later scales additive-rim alpha (R16); occlusion-after multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha); ACES-after applies to rgb+a passthrough; highlight adds rgb pulse; COLOR_BY_FOG (non-bloomfog, non-grid/legacy hologram) replaces via ApplyColorFog height-weighted blend; bloomfog blends rgb+a toward prepass via fogFactor (BlendFogColor selects a vs rgb vs full by _FOGTYPE_*; Lit defines none => full bloomfogCol overwrite). Height variant uses (heightFog*-fog+1) weighting. Plain FOG+HEIGHT (non-colorfog, non-grid/legacy) lerps rgb toward grey 0.1 by height factor (alpha preserved: float4(0.1,0.1,0.1,0)-result weighting keeps a). COLOR_BY_FOG bloom variant blends fogSource->fogTarget by 1-height*(1-fog).; dither adds (tex.r-0.5)/255 to rgb only (alpha preserved); dissolve edge lerps rgb toward _DissolveColorIntensity*instDissolveColor.rgb by dissolveFactor (alpha preserved). This terminal order (dither THEN edge lerp) is the audited fix #7.

operation_order: No transparency: defaults One/Zero RGB and Zero/Zero bloom-alpha => opaque; albedo.a is bloom (glow) channel consumed by bloom prepass/post, not transparency. Bloom-alpha writers: flipbook/plain/gradient/whiteboost emission, vertex emission, _RIMLIGHT_ADDITIVE overwrite, _RIMLIGHT_LERP overwrite via ApplyRimLight. Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); baseColor.a feeds COLOR_ARRAY path and vertex-color multiply; material color-array path multiplies rgb by _Intensity and a by _AlphaMultiplier (Lit 1750-1754). _VERTEXMODE_COLOR multiplies baseColor by i.color.; n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); baseColor.rgb scales ambient+direct (+lightmap) and tints fast/precise reflection multiply paths; occlusion multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha when after emission); occlusion-detail always multiplies rgb after distance-darkening; directDiffuse+directSpecular added into albedo rgb with metallic terms; groundFade scales directBaseColor pre-light and specular post-light; specular multiplied by occlusion when OCCLUSION (before emission ordering splits occlusion rgb timing); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic; alpha untouched here; albedo=0 then += (reflection+ambient+directDiffuse+directSpecular) with a=0; hologram adds rgb (grid*colorScale*intensity*holoColor; scanline scan*intensity*holoColor; legacy holo*holoColor); scanline forces a=0; distance-darkening multiplies rgb; occlusion-before (+detail) multiplies rgb before ACES/emission; ACES-before optional on rgb+a passthrough; parallax adds to rgb only (iridescent: +=blend*a; non-iridescent: +=layer*parallaxColor.rgb); alpha untouched; each emission writer does rgb+=color and a+=bloomAlpha (flipbook) or a=+bloomAlpha from 0-start (simple/pulse/SDF path starts emissionInput=0 then albedo.a+=bloomAlpha, so first writer sets alpha; flipbook path sets a= then +=vertex). Gradient: color=intensity*saturate(x*gradLUT), a=_TexBloomIntensity*intensity (luminance-independent). Vertex: rgb per whiteboost branch else color.rgb*a*threshold, a=vc.a^2*color.a*_EmissionBloom. Angle disappearance scales emissionInput pre-alpha-source; TEXTURE3D_EMISSION scales emissionColor.a pre-branch.; additive rim adds rgb and OVERWRITES a (=rim*scale*bloomI); lerp rim lerps rgb toward rimTarget and OVERWRITES a; UV-segment rim color overrides material rim color under _RIMLIGHT_LERP; occlusion-after-emission later scales additive-rim alpha (R16); occlusion-after multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha); ACES-after applies to rgb+a passthrough; highlight adds rgb pulse; COLOR_BY_FOG (non-bloomfog, non-grid/legacy hologram) replaces via ApplyColorFog height-weighted blend; bloomfog blends rgb+a toward prepass via fogFactor (BlendFogColor selects a vs rgb vs full by _FOGTYPE_*; Lit defines none => full bloomfogCol overwrite). Height variant uses (heightFog*-fog+1) weighting. Plain FOG+HEIGHT (non-colorfog, non-grid/legacy) lerps rgb toward grey 0.1 by height factor (alpha preserved: float4(0.1,0.1,0.1,0)-result weighting keeps a). COLOR_BY_FOG bloom variant blends fogSource->fogTarget by 1-height*(1-fog).; dither adds (tex.r-0.5)/255 to rgb only (alpha preserved); dissolve edge lerps rgb toward _DissolveColorIntensity*instDissolveColor.rgb by dissolveFactor (alpha preserved). This terminal order (dither THEN edge lerp) is the audited fix #7.

Bloom-alpha writers: flipbook/plain/gradient/whiteboost emission, vertex emission, _RIMLIGHT_ADDITIVE overwrite, _RIMLIGHT_LERP overwrite via ApplyRimLight. Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); baseColor.a feeds COLOR_ARRAY path and vertex-color multiply; material color-array path multiplies rgb by _Intensity and a by _AlphaMultiplier (Lit 1750-1754). _VERTEXMODE_COLOR multiplies baseColor by i.color.; n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); baseColor.rgb scales ambient+direct (+lightmap) and tints fast/precise reflection multiply paths; occlusion multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha when after emission); occlusion-detail always multiplies rgb after distance-darkening; directDiffuse+directSpecular added into albedo rgb with metallic terms; groundFade scales directBaseColor pre-light and specular post-light; specular multiplied by occlusion when OCCLUSION (before emission ordering splits occlusion rgb timing); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic; alpha untouched here; albedo=0 then += (reflection+ambient+directDiffuse+directSpecular) with a=0; hologram adds rgb (grid*colorScale*intensity*holoColor; scanline scan*intensity*holoColor; legacy holo*holoColor); scanline forces a=0; distance-darkening multiplies rgb; occlusion-before (+detail) multiplies rgb before ACES/emission; ACES-before optional on rgb+a passthrough; parallax adds to rgb only (iridescent: +=blend*a; non-iridescent: +=layer*parallaxColor.rgb); alpha untouched; each emission writer does rgb+=color and a+=bloomAlpha (flipbook) or a=+bloomAlpha from 0-start (simple/pulse/SDF path starts emissionInput=0 then albedo.a+=bloomAlpha, so first writer sets alpha; Vertex: rgb per whiteboost branch else color.rgb*a*threshold, a=vc.a^2*color.a*_EmissionBloom. Angle disappearance scales emissionInput pre-alpha-source; TEXTURE3D_EMISSION scales emissionColor.a pre-branch.; additive rim adds rgb and OVERWRITES a (=rim*scale*bloomI); lerp rim lerps rgb toward rimTarget and OVERWRITES a; UV-segment rim color overrides material rim color under _RIMLIGHT_LERP; occlusion-after-emission later scales additive-rim alpha (R16); occlusion-after multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha); ACES-after applies to rgb+a passthrough; highlight adds rgb pulse; COLOR_BY_FOG (non-bloomfog, non-grid/legacy hologram) replaces via ApplyColorFog height-weighted blend; bloomfog blends rgb+a toward prepass via fogFactor (BlendFogColor selects a vs rgb vs full by _FOGTYPE_*; Lit defines none => full bloomfogCol overwrite). Height variant uses (heightFog*-fog+1) weighting. Plain FOG+HEIGHT (non-colorfog, non-grid/legacy) lerps rgb toward grey 0.1 by height factor (alpha preserved: float4(0.1,0.1,0.1,0)-result weighting keeps a). This terminal order (dither THEN edge lerp) is the audited fix #7.

Bloom-alpha writers: flipbook/plain/gradient/whiteboost emission, vertex emission, _RIMLIGHT_ADDITIVE overwrite, _RIMLIGHT_LERP overwrite via ApplyRimLight. Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); baseColor.a feeds COLOR_ARRAY path and vertex-color multiply; material color-array path multiplies rgb by _Intensity and a by _AlphaMultiplier (Lit 1750-1754). _VERTEXMODE_COLOR multiplies baseColor by i.color.; n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); baseColor.rgb scales ambient+direct (+lightmap) and tints fast/precise reflection multiply paths; occlusion multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha when after emission); occlusion-detail always multiplies rgb after distance-darkening; directDiffuse+directSpecular added into albedo rgb with metallic terms; groundFade scales directBaseColor pre-light and specular post-light; specular multiplied by occlusion when OCCLUSION (before emission ordering splits occlusion rgb timing); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic; alpha untouched here; albedo=0 then += (reflection+ambient+directDiffuse+directSpecular) with a=0; hologram adds rgb (grid*colorScale*intensity*holoColor; scanline scan*intensity*holoColor; legacy holo*holoColor); scanline forces a=0; distance-darkening multiplies rgb; occlusion-before (+detail) multiplies rgb before ACES/emission; ACES-before optional on rgb+a passthrough; parallax adds to rgb only (iridescent: +=blend*a; non-iridescent: +=layer*parallaxColor.rgb); alpha untouched; each emission writer does rgb+=color and a+=bloomAlpha (flipbook) or a=+bloomAlpha from 0-start (simple/pulse/SDF path starts emissionInput=0 then albedo.a+=bloomAlpha, so first writer sets alpha; Angle disappearance scales emissionInput pre-alpha-source; TEXTURE3D_EMISSION scales emissionColor.a pre-branch.; additive rim adds rgb and OVERWRITES a (=rim*scale*bloomI); lerp rim lerps rgb toward rimTarget and OVERWRITES a; UV-segment rim color overrides material rim color under _RIMLIGHT_LERP; occlusion-after-emission later scales additive-rim alpha (R16); occlusion-after multiplies rgb (and additive-rim alpha); ACES-after applies to rgb+a passthrough; highlight adds rgb pulse; COLOR_BY_FOG (non-bloomfog, non-grid/legacy hologram) replaces via ApplyColorFog height-weighted blend; bloomfog blends rgb+a toward prepass via fogFactor (BlendFogColor selects a vs rgb vs full by _FOGTYPE_*; Lit defines none => full bloomfogCol overwrite). Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); Occlusion-after-emission also scales additive-rim alpha. Final return carries composed bloom alpha through fog/dither (fog/dither preserve or blend per BlendFogColor) to SV_Target.; n/a (compile-time only); baseColor.rgb only feeds lighting (diffuse/ambient/reflection tint); n/a (transport only); facing (VFACE) passed to fragment for dissolve backface falloff; color payload feeds vertex-emission and surface-material paths; cull only (no color); displacement only moves object-space position (and lookup rotates normal); no direct RGB/alpha; n/a (UV transport); flipbook rgb/alpha resolved in fragment; normal only tints lighting/reflection/parallax/rim/angle paths downstream; threshold gate only; edge color applied at very end (R24); reflection written to composableLighting.reflection rgb (added to albedo rgb at R12 head); rim-dim darkening + smoothness reduction + groundFade multiply reflection; MULTIPLY_REFLECTIONS tints by base/metallic;
